explanation: Re-analysis confirms no functional defects. The design uses multiple sequential always_ff blocks each driving distinct register sets (command state machine, Wishbone interface, FIFO control, CRC, watchdog). No register has multiple writers. The r_rsp_state, second_rsp_state, and other state registers are each assigned in exactly one always_ff block. Initial blocks properly initialize all state. The apparent duplication in the listing reflects separate always_ff blocks for separate register groups, not redundant drivers. No cycle-exact behavior change is required.
